name: Chase Home Lending (mortgage & home equity)
notes: Researched from public chase.com mortgage pages only. Managed in chase.com / Chase Mobile (Sign in with username). Payments from Chase or non-Chase deposit accounts (external accounts must be registered for mortgage payments); pay by phone 1-833-PayChase (1-833-729-2427); payments received by 7:30 p.m. ET weekdays post that day. Autopay: sign in, mortgage account, Set up under Amount due; mortgage frequencies monthly, twice a month or every two weeks; home equity monthly only; amount follows escrow/rate changes. Principal-only and escrow-shortage payments via Pay Mortgage > Principal/escrow/fee only. Grace period length and late fee amount are not published (not modelled). No card payments (bank-only inferred). Assistance 1-800-848-9380: repayment, forbearance, modification, reinstatement, short sale, deed-in-lieu.

autopay.note: Mortgages: monthly, twice a month or every two weeks. Home equity: monthly only.

help.title: Online and phone payments
paragraphs: Pay on chase.com or in the Chase Mobile app from a Chase or non-Chase checking or savings account. To pay from another bank, add it under Pay-from accounts > External accounts and register it for mortgage or home equity payments, even if you already use it for other Chase products.
Payments received by 7:30 p.m. ET Monday to Friday post that day, though they can take up to three business days to show online. You can also pay by phone at 1-833-PayChase (1-833-729-2427).

help.title: Automatic mortgage payments
paragraphs: Sign in, choose your mortgage or home equity account and select Set up under Amount due. Mortgages can be paid monthly, twice a month or every two weeks; home equity lines are monthly only.

Automatic payments adjust on their own when your escrow or interest rate changes, and you can add extra principal to each payment. With every-two-weeks payments, each payment is half of your monthly amount.
steps: Choose Set up under Amount due.
Pick the frequency and pay-from account, then confirm.

help.title: Principal-only and escrow shortage payments
paragraphs: To pay only principal, or to cover an escrow shortage, sign in and select Pay Mortgage, then choose Principal/escrow/fee only. Enter a shortage amount in Additional escrow/shortage and select Pay this bill.
Partial payments made before a full monthly payment show as unapplied funds until the full payment is covered. If your account is current, overpayments generally go to principal.

help.title: Mortgage assistance
paragraphs: To keep your home, Chase may offer a repayment plan (higher payments for a set time to catch up), forbearance (reduced or paused payments, with the missed amount due at the end), a modification of your loan terms, or reinstatement by paying the past-due amount in one lump sum.
If you choose to leave, options include a short sale, deed-in-lieu or a conventional sale. Call 1-800-848-9380.
